name: Cloud Technologies S.A.
summary: Cloud Technologies S.A. primarily focuses on big data marketing and the commercialization of data. The company's core product is OnAudience.com, a data management platform (DMP) responsible for aggregating and organizing internet user data from across the globe. Furthermore, it offers various marketing services that leverage this extensive data. Founded in 2011, Cloud Technologies S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
